solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Unhappy singleton really on the loose!

indicators.note: on the loose means running free, so these letters break out of their order and regroup

explanation.surface: An exclamation about a miserable single person now wildly free.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on the' looks like part of the indicator phrase, but those words are fodder; only 'loose' signals the rearrangement of REALLYONTHE.
explanation.definitionFit: A lonely heart is a person seeking love through personal ads, typically sad at being alone.

clue.text: They save ticket cost returning in rides with friends, for instance

indicators.note: in says the reversed piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: a lift is a ride in someone's car, as friends might give

indicators.note: returning means the word for ticket cost is read backwards

parts.note: the cost of a ticket is the fare

explanation.surface: Someone saving on tickets by cadging rides from friends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'They save' looks like thrifty passengers, but the definition means rescuers at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Inflatable rescue craft carried on ships save people from drowning.

clue.text: Hype before the end of weigh-ins is annoying

parts.note: hype is slang for a hypodermic needle

indicators.note: the end of picks the final letter of weigh-ins

explanation.surface: Pre-fight hype before boxers weigh in getting on everyone's nerves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hype' reads as publicity, but here it is the drug-user's slang for a hypodermic.
explanation.definitionFit: To needle someone is to provoke or irritate them, so the verb with -s matches 'is annoying'.

clue.text: To propose laws, members recently stopped by the heart of Westminster

indicators.note: stopped by means the central letter plugs a gap in the other pieces

parts.note: legs are limbs, i.e. members

indicators.note: the heart of picks the middle letter of Westminster

parts.note: late can mean recently, as in 'of late'

explanation.surface: MPs lately interrupted by business at the centre of Parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: The I from the middle of Westminster goes between LEG and SLATE.
explanation.definitionFit: Legislating is making or enacting laws, which starts with proposing them.

clue.text: Creature flying over the back of African lion

indicators.note: in a down clue, over places the first piece above the next

parts.note: a lion is a celebrated person, a hero

indicators.note: the back of picks the last letter of African

explanation.surface: Some animal soaring above an African lion's back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lion' is not the animal but a celebrity, a sense also seen in 'social lion'.
explanation.definitionFit: This long-legged wading bird is a creature that flies.

clue.text: Light meal eaten by a bishop and judge

indicators.note: eaten by means the snack goes inside the following pieces

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the title of a bishop
a bite is a snack, a light meal

explanation.surface: A cleric and a judge sharing a snack.
explanation.walkthrough: RR, for Right Reverend, is a bishop's title; the snack splits its two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: An arbiter settles disputes, acting as a referee or judge.

clue.text: Show-off starts to turn ugly when on edge

indicators.note: in a down clue, on places the first piece on top of the next
starts to picks the opening letters of turn and ugly

parts.note: a lip is an edge or rim

explanation.surface: A braggart turning nasty when they get nervous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Show-off' is a playful definition: the flower makes a showy display.
explanation.definitionFit: This brightly coloured spring bloom is famously showy, so it is called a show-off.

clue.text: Source of leak found during extensive search

indicators.note: found during places the letter within the word for extensive

parts.note: rife means widespread, extensive

indicators.note: Source of takes the opening letter of leak

explanation.surface: Investigators hunting widely for whoever leaked a story.
explanation.definitionFit: To rifle through something is to search it hurriedly and thoroughly.

clue.text: They cook bread that's on order

indicators.note: on joins the pieces end to end

parts.note: roti is an Indian flatbread
that's shortens to 's, the S
a series is an ordered sequence

explanation.surface: Bakers producing bread that has been ordered in advance.
explanation.definitionFit: Rotating spits for roasting meat are appliances that cook.

clue.text: General ultimately displaying a mean ego

indicators.note: ultimately picks the final letter of displaying

parts.note: ribald means coarse or vulgar, i.e. low and mean
ego is the self, I

explanation.surface: An army leader finally showing a nasty, selfish streak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'General' looks like an adjective, but it is the Italian military leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Giuseppe Garibaldi was the general who led the campaign to unify Italy.

clue.text: Individuals welcomed by people from Delhi and people from Bali?

indicators.note: welcomed by means taken in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: Delhi is in India, so its people are Indians
ones are single individuals

explanation.surface: Visitors received by Indians and Balinese alike.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks Bali as an example, one island among many.
explanation.definitionFit: Bali is an island province of Indonesia, so its natives are citizens of that country.

clue.text: The shivers, the endless runs and ailments

indicators.note: endless means the final letter is lopped off the word

parts.note: R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for runs
ills are ailments

explanation.surface: A list of symptoms: shivering, diarrhoea and other illnesses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the runs' suggests an upset stomach, but 'the' is clipped and 'runs' is cricket's R.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrills are sudden waves of excitement, the tingling shivers felt down the spine.

clue.text: Journalists housed in well-known block for writers

indicators.note: housed in means one piece is accommodated inside the other

parts.note: noted means famous, well-known
PA is the Press Association, a body of journalists

explanation.surface: Reporters living in a famous building for authors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'block' looks like a building, but it is a pad of paper.
explanation.definitionFit: A pad of sheets bound at one edge is a block of paper for jotting.

clue.text: Very fine cover for armless seats

parts.note: so means very, as in 'so good'
F is the pencil-grade abbreviation for fine

indicators.note: cover for picks the outside letters of armless

explanation.surface: A lovely throw to put over chairs without arms.
explanation.definitionFit: Settees are upholstered seats for several people.

clue.text: Prove a race isn't fixed

indicators.note: a fixed race is rigged, and here the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A demand to show that a horse race wasn't rigged.
explanation.definitionFit: To find out for certain or establish that something is true is to prove it.

clue.text: Queen and king running to palace guards

indicators.note: guards means the rearranged letters surround the other piece
running here means in motion, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: R, for Rex, is the abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Royal couple hurrying to the palace past the guards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'running' rearranges TO PALACE into CLEOPATA, which 'guards' R near its end.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous last ruler of Ptolemaic Egypt was its queen.

clue.text: Reviewer of software right to receive pay increase

indicators.note: to receive places the last piece at the end, receiving the others in front of it

parts.note: an app is a piece of software
a raise is an increase in pay

explanation.surface: A software critic deserving a raise.
explanation.definitionFit: An assessor of value, like a valuer or evaluator, reviews things to judge their worth.

clue.text: Heard Labour's leader eff and blind? Not in this place!

indicators.note: Heard says the pieces are spoken aloud to give the entry

parts.note: the leading letter of Labour is L, and to eff and blind is to swear, so the words say L SWEAR

explanation.surface: A Labour leader cursing in public, shocking those who'd never do so here.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eff and blind' is British slang for swearing heavily. Said aloud, L SWEAR gives the entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Somewhere other than here means in another place, not this one.

clue.text: One bill established in Washington and another US city

indicators.note: established in means set up inside, so these pieces go within the state abbreviation

parts.note: WA is the postal abbreviation for Washington state
I is the Roman numeral for one
a chit is a bill or note of money owed

explanation.surface: A single bill passed in Washington DC.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' refers back to Washington, itself a US city.
explanation.definitionFit: This largest city of Kansas is a city of the United States.

clue.text: Overturning some in-house policies takes great strides

indicators.note: Overturning says the hidden letters are read backwards
some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A company scrapping internal rules makes big progress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'great strides' looks like progress, but here it means long running steps.
explanation.definitionFit: To run with long bounding steps, like a wolf or horse, is to move in great strides.

clue.text: Withstand knocking back a large beer

indicators.note: knocking back means the first pieces are turned around

parts.note: L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
stout is a dark beer

explanation.surface: Somebody resisting the temptation to sink a big pint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocking back' suggests drinking but here turns A L into LA.
explanation.definitionFit: To last out is to endure or survive to the end, i.e. withstand.

clue.text: Numerical lists consisting of cubes?

parts.note: in means made of or consisting of, as in 'a dress in silk'
to dice food is to cut it into cubes, so cubes as a verb is dices

explanation.surface: A query whether some lists are made up of cubed numbers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cubes' looks like a noun about powers, but it is the cooking verb.
explanation.definitionFit: An index in a book is an alphabetical list with page numbers.

clue.text: Start detailed logging, essentially, to clear errors

indicators.note: detailed means de-tailed, losing the final letter

parts.note: a debut is a first appearance, a start

indicators.note: essentially picks the central letter of logging

explanation.surface: Advice to log in detail so that software faults can be fixed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' looks like thorough, but read as de-tailed it drops the T.
explanation.definitionFit: Removing faults from computer code is called this, ridding a program of bugs.

clue.text: Group of leg muscles moving bottom to top

indicators.note: in a down clue, moving bottom to top shifts the last letter up to the start

parts.note: quads are the quadriceps, thigh muscles

explanation.surface: An exercise for a set of leg muscles, working up the body.
explanation.definitionFit: A team or unit of people, such as a sports team, is a group.

clue.text: It is put in lasagne, perhaps

definitions.text: It is put in lasagne, perhaps

indicators.note: is put in means the first piece goes inside the second

parts.note: lasagne is an example of pasta
it is slang for sex appeal, abbreviated SA

explanation.surface: A cook's note about an ingredient that goes into a lasagne.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Sieved tomato sauce is layered into lasagne along with the meat sauce.

clue.text: Initially strike over type of fuel, it's assumed

indicators.note: Initially picks the first letter of strike

parts.note: O is the cricket scoring abbreviation for over
a briquet is a block of compressed coal dust or charcoal burnt as fuel

explanation.surface: Miners walking out over a fuel issue, as everyone supposed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it's assumed' looks like a link phrase, but it defines a name one takes on.
explanation.definitionFit: A nickname is a name that is taken on or adopted, i.e. assumed.

clue.text: Old, unchanged rock group

parts.note: as is means unchanged, in its present state

explanation.surface: A veteran band that has never altered its line-up.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gallagher brothers fronted this Manchester Britpop band.

clue.text: Skilled gamer is smart when playing with danger

indicators.note: playing means toying with, so the letters are juggled into new order

explanation.surface: A clever player gambles with risk.
explanation.definitionFit: The top title in chess goes to an expert player of that game.
